text:
Leah (growth): Quick sync — post-launch checklist + webinar lead routing. We need a final pass on keywords, schema for the event page, internal linking from the blog pieces, and a redirects plan for the old /launch posts -> new hub. Can we triage owners? :eyes:
Miguel (content): I can own the copy side and KW finalization. I have 6 priority seed keywords and longtails ready, will paste after this thread.
Ava (SEO): Thanks — I'll own schema + canonical + internal link anchors. Will also do the redirect map review with Jonas.
Jonas (web): I'll handle the redirect rules and confirm they won't conflict with current GA/UTM setup. Quick Q: do we want 301 for all old launch URLs or preserve some landing variants?
Leah (growth): 301 for canonicalized content. For A/B CTA variants keep the variant param and route to canonical landing with UTM_source=launch_ab so we can segment. Avoid preserving duplicate-indexable pages.
Miguel (content): Draft KW list (high level): "redwood inference integration", "LLM inference latency best practices", "model serving cost optimization" + longtails like "how to reduce token cost on gpt-style models". Will attach full csv to the drive.
Ava (SEO): For schema: event + breadcrumb + FAQ + speakership markup. Minimal JSON-LD we should add to the webinar landing:
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Benchmarking LLM Inference: latency, cost, and reliability",
  "startDate": "2026-04-21T16:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.example.com/webinars/llm-benchmarks" },
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" },
  "performer": [{ "@type": "Person", "name": "Dr. Anita Rao" }]
}
</script>
```
Ava (SEO): Also add FAQPage schema for the three common questions about setup, infra, and cost. That helps SERP real estate for webinar posts.
Jonas (web): For redirects: I'll prepare a mapping file. Proposal: single CSV with columns old_url,new_url,redirect_type,reason,owner. I'll scope the initial sweep to /launch/* and /blog/benchmarking/* and exclude /docs/* for now.
Leah (growth): Sounds good. Also: internal linking plan — need 2 contextual links from each of the 4 launch posts to the new webinar landing + 1 link from the benchmark narrative to the docs (best-practices). Keep anchor text targeting the priority keywords Miguel listed.
Miguel (content): I'll make anchor suggestions per paragraph. Example: "model serving cost optimization" -> links to /blog/model-serving-costs with ?utm_campaign=launch_post.
Ava (SEO): On canonical headers: ensure server returns rel=canonical for all older variants. Where we have query-driven variants for experiments, canonical should point to the base landing. Jonas — can you add canonical header enforcement in CDN edge rules?
Jonas (web): Yup — CDN rule will strip known experiment params (utm_*, ab, variant) when generating canonical. I'll put together the Terraform patch and a dry-run in staging.
Leah (growth): Lead routing: registrants should map into SFDC campaigns by UTM_campaign=launch_2026 and route regional leads to the right SDR buckets (region param: us/eu/apac). We want webhook events for registrant -> send to /webhooks/leads with payload {email, name, utm_campaign, region}.
Ava (SEO): One more SEO nuance: pagination for the launch content hub — add rel=prev/next on the archive and ensure the hub page has consolidated TF-IDF content to prevent keyword cannibalization.
Miguel (content): Will craft the hub intro copy to centralize intent and call out the webinar. That should reduce cannibalization.
Jonas (web): I'll draft the redirect CSV and push to the ops repo under /infra/redirects/launch-2026.csv. Expect PR by EOD.
Leah (growth): Timeline: today = owners assigned, by tomorrow morning = redirect CSV + KW csv + JSON-LD snippets, by Friday = staging deploy + canonical check, next Monday = go-live + monitor.
Ava (SEO): I'll run a smoke test after staging deploy: crawl the hub, verify JSON-LD, check canonical headers, and validate sitemap entries for the webinar page.
Miguel (content): Tagging naming convention to use in copy/links: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_2026, utm_content=[cta_variant]. Use hyphen separators.
seo-bot: Reminder: run structured data test after adding JSON-LD — https://search.google.com/test/rich-results :robot_face:
Leah (growth): @Miguel @Ava @Jonas — thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping me. I'll consolidate the checklist and post the drive links here when Miguel uploads the CSVs. :rocket:
